items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: And it sounds like Chopin and that type of thing.

ctx.x: The music is very interesting. It's very much Sidney. He was tremendously influenced by late 19th century romantic music. And it sounds like Chopin and that type of thing. Then the blues comes in, you know.

I never got much of an impression, you know, from him playing it. Maybe for five minutes he picked out parts of it to show us. And he was struggling a good deal with the piano. By the way, do you remember, did he play on it himself? Yes, he did. I got the idea that he was soloist, special soloist.
